'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Nick Reisch LS Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker) (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nick Reisch]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker) (V)|V10-L-hothmainpowergenerators.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
